reasoning_trace.description: MANDATORY: You MUST describe what you see in the images (Charts, System Models) to prove you have analyzed them.
reasoning_trace.value: The paper presents a system model for the coexistence of distributed sensing and ultra-simple coherent RoF based front-haul for radio access networks. The system uses a commercially available coherent modulator to achieve signal modulation and remote up-conversion. The linear frequency modulated carrier enables distributed sensing while simultaneously serving as the beat tone of RoF communication.

reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The system mechanism is based on the use of a linear frequency modulated (LFM) carrier to enable distributed sensing and RoF communication. The LFM carrier is modulated using a commercially available coherent driver module (CDM) and is used as the beat tone for RoF communication. The system uses a probabilistic constellation shaping (PCS) QAM signal and a pre-compensation algorithm to optimize transmission performance.

reasoning_trace.description: Validate the physical consistency of reported metrics (Rate/Resolution).
reasoning_trace.value: The system achieves a distributed sensing detection sensitivity of 28 pε/√Hz and supports 1.6 GBaud 16 QAM radio transmission in the Ka-band of 28 GHz. The system also demonstrates robust communication performance for a wide range of CSPR values.

reasoning_trace.description: Identify the solved problems and remaining open challenges.
reasoning_trace.value: The system solves the problem of integrating distributed sensing and RoF communication in a single system. However, the system still faces challenges such as nonlinear distortion and modulation-induced noise, which can impact transmission performance. The system also requires further optimization to improve its robustness and accuracy.
